name: GoSearch MCP
description:
GoSearch connects your AI assistant to your organization's knowledge base. Ask a question and get answers pulled from the apps your team already uses, like Google Drive, Slack, Jira, Notion, and 100+ more, all in one place.

Use it two ways:
- Search across your connected apps to find the document, message, or ticket you need, with links back to the source.
- Ask GoAI a question and get a written answer grounded in your organization's content, with citations so you can verify where it came from.

GoSearch respects your existing permissions, so you only see results from content you already have access to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GoSearch MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GoSearch MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.gosearch.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GoSearch MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GoSearch MCP provides these MCP tools: goai_response and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GoSearch MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GoSearch MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does GoSearch MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: GoSearch MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GoSearch MCP is developed by GoSearch. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
